## Advisory approach
- Requirements are defined around the client's usable budget, location needs, purpose, timeline and financing position.
- Property comparisons include relevant disadvantages, price context, documentation, financing constraints and resale or rental considerations where applicable.
- Seller submissions are reviewed privately and do not become public property listings automatically.
- Home-loan approvals, legal opinions, tax advice and registration decisions remain subject to the relevant lender, authority or qualified professional.

Property availability, prices, financing and transaction requirements change. Confirm current facts directly with Shubh Estate Brokers and use appropriate legal, tax and banking professionals.
